info.name: Hot Tracks
info.summary: Store your Strava activities privately in Nextcloud
info.description:
Hot Tracks allows you to connect to your Strava account via API. It will sync your activities and store them for your leisure in a folder in your Nextcloud. Your data, your files, your cloud.

It will also list the activities and print a heatmap. It will also generate a link to bikerouter.de with the track encoded. It may do more than that in the future. Use the issue tracker on GitHub.

Notes:
You will need a paid subscription to use the API. You would need one subscription (Administration settings) for the server. Multiple users will then be able to connect via a click on the Strava-connect button. They all share the API usage limit. At least, that's the theory.

You can also use an auth proxy.
info.author: Walter Precht
